title: Las maletas
goal: Help somebody with bags and refuse the money
culture: The mirror of the cargador in the market: there, you paid somebody to carry, and agreeing the price first was the whole etiquette. Here you are the one carrying, and refusing the money is. She will offer, because everybody who lifts a bag in that terminal is paid for it.

beats.es: Ay, Dios... perdón, joven, es que son muchas.
beats.good: Offer first. There is no version of this where she asks you, and the offer is the whole of the kindness.

beats.es: ¡Ay, mi hijo, gracias! ¿Y cuánto le doy?
beats.good: She offers because everybody who lifts a bag in this terminal is paid for it. No es nada declines without leaving her owing you.

beats.es: Pero es que usted se molestó por mí...
beats.good: No se preocupe closes it. A third refusal after this would start making it about you.

beats.es: Que Dios se lo pague, mi hijo. De verdad.
beats.en: All the best to you, doña.
beats.good: Que Dios se lo pague is the largest thank-you there is here and it is not answered in kind. Que le vaya bien is the right size.
